## Checklist

- [ ] Follows `docs/blueprint-format.md`
- [ ] Universal by default; country, industry and size specifics are in `VARIATIONS.md`
- [ ] Every rule that would be a bug if broken is in `INVARIANTS.md` with a test
- [ ] Invented data only; no real customers, people, amounts or IDs
- [ ] `node scripts/check.mjs` passes
- [ ] For a new blueprint: linked proposal issue, and your handle in `authors`
